svg.text: CUDA Deep Neural Network Library - docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn - declarative Graph API + fused GPU kernels
L1 - Framework Integration + Workloads (specialized DNN primitives - sibling to cuBLAS at application layer)
L2 - Programming Model (context-based API - declarative operation graphs - decoupled from engine implementation)
Deprecated in v9 - still via shim layer
Declarative dataflow graph of tensor ops
Math spec decoupled from engine choice
Optional CUDA stream per execution plan
Keep intermediates in SMEM - save BW
L3 - API Surface (Backend descriptors - Graph API core - legacy sub-libraries)
Mode B: NN-based higher accuracy 10-100x CPU
Fallback: functional support w/o perf guarantee
cudnn_cnn: conv descriptors + legacy conv API
cudnn_ops: BN softmax dropout reduce pool
cudnn_adv: RNN CTC loss multihead attn
All legacy depends on cudnn_graph indirectly
L4 - Graph Execution Pipeline (build graph - validate - heuristics - execution plan - variant pack - launch)
Add ops + tensor UIDs to OperationGraph
Pick first supported or auto-tune best
Map tensor UIDs to device pointers
L5 - Engine Families (four engine classes - precompiled vs runtime-compiled - generic vs specialized)
JIT kernel gen at runtime - surfaces 90/80/70
Hand-tuned fusion for hot model patterns
Split-K tile size CTA config tuning
L6 - Sub-library Package Layout (v9 split - dlopen engine loading - selective install for disk/memory savings)
Fused SDPA Execution Path (Flash Attention - BMM-Softmax-BMM graph pattern)
Frontend sdpa node or manual OperationGraph - specialized runtime fusion engine
Step 1: Build graph Q K V - Matmul QK^T - scale - mask - Softmax - Matmul Attn V
Step 2: Optional: causal mask alibi dropout paged attn FP8 scale/descale subgraphs
Step 3: cudnnBackendFinalize - EngineHeur Mode A ranks specialized SDPA engines
Step 4: Create ExecutionPlan - allocate workspace - VariantPack bind Q K V O ptrs
Step 5: cudnnBackendExecute - fused kernel keeps softmax tile in SMEM - minimal HBM
PyTorch SDPA backend may route to cuDNN fused attn on supported shapes and dtypes
Generic runtime fusion: g1 pointwise DAG + conv/matmul + g2 pointwise DAG - surfaces 90/80/70
Conv+BN+ReLU: NormAddRelu specialized engine for vision forward - DReluForkDNorm for backward
NVIDIA reference DNN primitive library - frameworks call cuDNN for conv norm attn not GEMM
cudnn-frontend: build graph - get_heuristics - build_plan - execute(variant_pack)
Design Position (NVIDIA DNN primitive layer - graph-driven fusion beats unfused op chains on memory BW)
Operation graph + heuristics + multi-class engines = out-of-box peak conv norm attn on every NVIDIA GPU gen
Init: cudnnCreate - dlopen engine/heuristic libs - device prop query - handle per thread/context
Loop: build graph - finalize - heuristics - execution plan - variant pack - execute - optional CUDA Graph
